notes: Main article only, no supplementary file. Original experimental paper: gas-phase H2 uptake by a differential-pressure volumetric apparatus (12 MPa, ambient/298 K), CNFs from Fe/Ni/Cu-catalysed ethylene growth (carbon yield 22-23 g per g catalyst, so carbon is the majority by mass). Uptake values in Table 1: 1.66/3.54 wt% (90:5:5, as prepared/Ar treated) and 4.18/6.54 wt% (85:10:5). Electrochemical storage in CNFs is mentioned only as an unpublished remark ('Mellor, in preparation'), with no data, so I1 is not an electrochemistry case. record.json is_retracted is false and the page images show no retraction notice. The paper does not state that its uptake values were published before.
